meta.format: <id>.i16z: Int16 grid v, row 0 = north, origin = top-left corner of pixel (0,0); height_m = v * h_scale + h_offset; v == nodata_value -> no data
meta.encoding: delta2d-planes-gzip: gzip of [low bytes, high bytes] of d = 2D first difference of v (axis 1 then axis 0, prepend 0, wrapping mod 2^16); decode with a wrapping 2D prefix sum
meta.method: NaN-aware area mean over (full_size / size)^2 blocks of the full tile, then Int16
